**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is looking for advice on organic pest control methods for their garden.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Organic pest control methods recommended include encouraging beneficial insects, using neem oil, spray soaps, diatomaceous earth, companion planting, crop rotation, hand-picking, traps, biological controls, cultural controls, physical barriers, and insecticidal soap.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Neem oil is derived from the seeds of the neem tree and can control pests like aphids, whiteflies, and spider mites.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For neem oil application, mix 2-4 teaspoons of neem oil per quart of water and spray on affected plants.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Neem oil should be applied in the early morning or evening to avoid burning the plants.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Neem oil should be reapplied every 7-10 days, or every 3-4 days for severe infestations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Neem oil can be toxic to bees, so it should be applied when they are less active.
- [USER] The user has been having issues with aphids on their tomato plants.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Neem oil is effective against aphids as it disrupts their hormonal system and can help reduce their numbers.
